The largest case-median candidate/baseline ratio is 1.3891891098983489; 5 rows exceed 10%, and 51 rows change allocator observations. The affected inverse-trigonometric corpus has 33 cases and 12 alternating baseline/candidate processes with raw Criterion samples. Iso coefficients and area expressions consume existing exact scalar proofs; one necessary scalar certificate preserves acos(±1/2) as exact multiples of pi. limits: All 28 work-package gates remain open. This finite convex-sector/native-grid domain does not establish general Boolean closure, arbitrary-angle completion, nonlinear coincidence or general curved-shell embedding. Complete operation receipts and downstream provenance/certainty delivery remain open. Torus/cone STEP export remains typed UnsupportedSurface. No total-work, retained-heap, expression-growth or cancellation bound is claimed; external watchdogs contain checks. WASM uses workspace paths, not a shipped JS/package consumer. Runtime fuzz/ASan, lexicase, instrumented coverage, machine-checked proofs, package/MSRV and actual C/Python/JS release gates remain open.
